HowItWorks.heading: How It Works
HowItWorks.intro: Booking a yacht is easier than you think.
HowItWorks.introSecondLine: We guide you from choosing a destination to stepping on board - no experience needed.

destination.title: Choose destination
destination.description: Explore over 1,200 sailing destinations worldwide. From Croatia to the Caribbean - pick the place that fits your trip.

yacht.title: Select your yacht
yacht.description: Browse yachts based on your group size, budget, and preferences. Compare options and find the best fit for your trip.

book.title: Book your trip
book.description: Confirm your dates, add extras if needed, and secure your booking online. You're ready to sail.

checklist.explore: Explore the best yachts for your trip

preferences.title: Choose preferences
preferences.description: Specify your ideal destinations, from the turquoise coasts of Palawan to the historic harbors of Valetta.

recommendation.title: Get recommendation
recommendation.description: We'll suggest yachts based on your group's needs. Review our recommendations and select the perfect yacht.

yachts.title: View yachts
yachts.description: Finalize the details, add any extras, and book. Now you can anticipate your unforgettable yachting adventure.

weber.quote: We booked a yacht in Croatia for the first time and everything just worked. The process was simple, and the boat was exactly what we expected.

martin.quote: I had no sailing experience, but the platform made it easy to find a skipper and plan the whole trip. It felt like a regular holiday, just better.

carter.quote: The price transparency was the biggest surprise. We could see the full cost upfront and split it between friends - super convenient.

rossi.quote: We compared a few yachts and found the perfect one for our group. The route suggestions were really helpful - we didn't have to plan anything.

kowalska.quote: Great selection of boats and very clear filters. We found exactly what we needed in just a few minutes.

jensen.quote: Everything from booking to boarding felt effortless. Clear communication, no hidden fees, and a boat that looked even better in person.
